description:
[Deterministic public procurement validation. Pure calculation, read-only, side-effect free]. Validates Italian ANAC CIG (10-character alphanumeric checksum, Ordinary CIG and SmartCIG under D.Lgs 36/2023) and CUP (15-character public investment code) against official tender registry structure.
Usage: Use this tool to verify public tender code validity. For tender threshold and publication deadline calculations, use 'bando_thresholds_calculator' instead.
Returns: JSON object with { cig: { valid: boolean, type: 'ORDINARY' | 'SMART' | null, checksumOk: boolean }, cup: { valid: boolean, lengthOk: boolean }, isValid: boolean }.
name: cig_cup_anac_validator
